biggest_catch: Bodalgo is a real casting platform with a no-commission policy, but its official pages publish no concrete pay figures at all — no rate range, no minimum, no per-word or per-hour floor — so there is nothing verifiable to promise a worker.
catches: Official FAQ confirms talents set their own rates and Bodalgo charges no commission, but 'rates vary by scope, usage, timeframe' with no numbers attached.
Concrete rates ($0.10/word, $35/hr) appear only on individual talent profiles — those are one person's asking prices, not platform pay evidence.
No guaranteed volume; casting-based, competition-driven work.
